comment: Independent C-first controlled teleport onto wished ICE. C's first recording showed that startup's welcome --More-- consumed the original first wish command; this corrected input starts with one space to clear that observed welcome page, then wishes ICE and the scroll. The remaining read-scroll and getpos prompt/tip inputs follow the separately observed C boundaries. Escape closes the first-use TIP_GETPOS window and '.' picks the initial cursor on ICE. scrolltele calls teleds, whose source calls spoteffects(TRUE) for the accepted same-square destination.
